analyst_view.overall: An Emilia derby between two sides in good spirits: Parma won 3-0 at Atalanta on Monday in Alberto Gilardino's first game, and Raffaele Palladino's Bologna have won three in a row. Neither side played in Europe this week, and the absentees match the site's list (Bernabé and Drobnic for Parma; Holm, De Silvestri and Enem for Bologna).

goals.text: The numbers say 2.2 goals. Parma are expected in a 3-5-2 that defends deep, which fits a low total, but both sides arrive scoring freely, so nothing pushes us either way.

corners.text: The numbers say 8.3 corners. Nothing in the team news changes how either side builds attacks, so we stay with the numbers.

cards.text: The numbers say 3.1 cards. It's a local derby between two teams with momentum, and Palladino expects a physical Parma that presses high at times, so we lean a little higher. We found no recent record for referee Luca Zufferli, so this rests on the occasion alone.

shots.text: The numbers say 22.6 shots. Bologna's front three (Bernardeschi, Odgaard, Cambiaghi) should see most of the ball, as the numbers already expect, and we found nothing to move it.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 7.1 shots on target. No news points either way.
